# A dormant top-rate defect satisfies every scalar stress and entropy test

This is an EXACT geometric and actual-cap-law feasibility certificate.
It is NOT a selected-minimum example: its actual caps do not share one
critical volume, and its threshold law is continuous. Those omissions
are stated precisely below. The certificate shows that the new entropy
repair bounds cannot by themselves turn the existing scalar physical
stress and inverse-rate kernel into a positive captured-mass payment.
The signed stress can vanish on a nonzero canonical inverse defect.

## 1. Actual positive convex bodies and normalized affine denominators

Fix 0<beta<1 and let lambda decrease to zero. In R^2 put

    K_lambda={(x,y):0<=x<=1, |y|<=x+lambda}.

These are full-dimensional compact convex bodies with area
M_lambda=1+2lambda, a common interior ball for small lambda, and a
common bounded containing ball. Their limit is the triangle
K_0={(x,y):0<=x<=1, |y|<=x}.

There is a unique epsilon_lambda>0 such that the affine function

    L_lambda(x,y)=c_lambda(x+epsilon_lambda),
    c_lambda=exp[-(1/M_lambda) integral_K log(x+epsilon_lambda) dxdy]

satisfies

    min_K L_lambda=c_lambda epsilon_lambda=exp(-beta/lambda). (1)

Indeed the continuous function

    F_lambda(epsilon)=log epsilon
             -(1/M_lambda) integral_K log(x+epsilon) dxdy

is strictly increasing: its derivative is
1/epsilon-E[1/(x+epsilon)]>0, because the volume law has x>0 almost
everywhere. Its range is (-infinity,0). The required value is
-beta/lambda, proving existence and uniqueness.

By construction the actual geometric normalization is exact:

    (1/M_lambda) integral_K log L_lambda=0.             (2)

We have epsilon_lambda->0 and c_lambda->sqrt(e). To verify this,
F_lambda at any fixed positive epsilon stays bounded as lambda->0,
so the solutions of F_lambda=-beta/lambda tend to zero. The integral
is especially simple to control. Eventually epsilon_lambda<1, and
log x<=log(x+epsilon_lambda)<=log 2. Hence its normalized expectation
lies between -(1/2+2lambda)/(1+2lambda) and log 2, giving uniform
positive upper and lower bounds for c_lambda directly. Also
integral_0^1(-log(x+epsilon_lambda))_+dx<=1. Thus the part weighted by
2lambda has integral tending to zero. Dominated convergence for the
remaining 2x weight gives

    E_K log(x+epsilon_lambda)->integral_0^1 2x log x dx=-1/2.

Consequently c_lambda->sqrt(e), and (1) gives
lambda log(1/epsilon_lambda)->beta.

## 2. Exact surface and inverse-rate defects

Let e=(1,0) and r_lambda=lambda(-log L_lambda)_+.
The left facet x=0 has normal -e, length 2lambda, and constant rate
beta by (1). Its surface logarithmic measure therefore has total
mass 2beta exactly. The facet shrinks to w_*=(0,0), giving

    mu_e=2beta delta_(w_*,beta).                        (3)

There is no other surface logarithmic defect. The top and bottom
edges have x parameter, uniformly bounded length Jacobians, and
uniformly integrable logarithms by
integral_0^delta -log(x+epsilon)dx<=delta(1-log delta)+o(1).
The facet x=1 has bounded logarithm. Thus (3) is the full defect.

Consider the directional gradient-weighted inverse measure

    N_lambda=|grad L_lambda| dm/L_lambda=dm/(x+epsilon_lambda).

At a positive rate s, solve

    x=c_lambda^(-1)exp(-s/lambda)-epsilon_lambda.

Since dx/(x+epsilon_lambda)=-ds/lambda, the exact rate density,
where 0<s<beta and x is in [0,1], is

    2(x+lambda)/lambda
       =2+2[c_lambda^(-1)exp(-s/lambda)-epsilon_lambda]/lambda.

On every compact subinterval of (0,beta) it converges uniformly to 2,
and x,y tend to zero there. Direct integration of the inverse mass
shows that the entire positive-rate defect is

    N_e=2 delta_w* tensor Lebesgue|_(0,beta).           (4)

For completeness,

    N_lambda(K_lambda)
      =2+2(lambda-epsilon_lambda)
                     log[(1+epsilon_lambda)/epsilon_lambda]
      ->2+2beta.

The ordinary limiting inverse mass is 2, so the remaining mass is
exactly 2beta, agreeing with (4). No additional rate-zero defect is
left. Equations (3)-(4) satisfy the full uniform-kernel identity
N_e=K mu_e. The canonical right-continuous inverse density is

    v_e(R)=2 delta_w*       for 0<R<beta,
    v_e(R)=0               for R>=beta,                (5)

with left value v_e(beta-)=2 delta_w*.

## 3. Actual caps realize exact cancellation of the physical density

For 0<=s<=beta use the ACTUAL closed ambient halfspace

    H_(lambda,s)={L_lambda>=exp(-s/lambda)}.

It is an ordinary halfspace because L_lambda is affine, with continuous
normal a positive multiple of e. Give these caps Lebesgue probability
weight ds on [0,beta]. Give one cap H_empty={x>=2}, which misses K_lambda,
the remaining weight 1-beta. This defines a probability law theta_lambda
of actual halfspaces. It uses their literal selectors; the parameter
values where a cap is supporting have ds measure zero, so supporting
allocation choices do not affect W_lambda.

For each physical point of K_lambda, (1) ensures 0<=r_lambda<=beta.
The cap condition is exactly s>=r_lambda when L_lambda<1; when L_lambda
>=1 every parameter s is captured. Thus the actual cap load is

    W_lambda=integral 1_H dtheta_lambda
            =beta-r_lambda                            (6)

at EVERY point of the body and its boundary. In particular W_lambda=0
on the shrinking facet carrying (3).

The scalar physical density

    Xi_lambda=W_lambda-beta+r_lambda

is IDENTICALLY zero. Hence every normal-weighted convex physical stress
inequality holds with equality, including arbitrarily growing moving
hinges and all globally finite perspective-entropy tests. Its actual
Jordan surface martingale is the zero-mass law. All new discounted
repair bounds hold with zero mass and zero entropy; there is no
nonzero paired branch to which an inverse defect can be assigned.

All caps in theta_lambda have positive-parallel continuous normal.
Thus the canonical noninside captured measure is zero:

    v_e^noninside(R)=0.                                  (7)

The moving-hinge payment is an equality at every 0<R<beta:

    R v_e(R)+integral_R^beta v_e(s)ds=beta v_e(R).         (8)

The closed-tail endpoint version is also exact at R=beta. Every actual
cap selection is retained. Its inside section fluxes, rather than a
fictional limiting halfspace bit, account for whatever positive inverse
volume a threshold cap captures.

Those fluxes can also be computed explicitly. For fixed 0<s<beta,
the H_(lambda,s) section is at
x=c_lambda^(-1)exp(-s/lambda)-epsilon_lambda. Its length is asymptotic
to 2lambda, its logarithmic rate is exactly s, and its logarithmic
section mass tends to 2s. Normalize its cap normal to e. Then

    alpha_(e,H_s)=0,
    section_(e,H_s)=2s delta_(w_*,s),
    N_(e,H_s)=2 delta_w* tensor Lebesgue|_(0,s).

This is precisely the signed inside-cap kernel with coefficient
e dot u=1. After integration over the ORIGINAL cap law, the full
captured inverse density is

    integral v_(e,H)(R) dtheta(H)
       =2(beta-R)delta_w*           for 0<R<beta.

All of this capture belongs to the inside exception; none can be
silently reclassified as the noninside term in (7).

## 4. Even the averaged cap-volume budget can be made exact

The previous display used beta as the scalar stress offset. Define
instead the ACTUAL averaged normalized cap volume

    beta_lambda=(1/M_lambda) integral |K_lambda intersect H| dtheta_lambda
                =beta-lambda A_lambda,
    A_lambda=(1/M_lambda) integral_K (-log L_lambda)_+ dm.

The numbers A_lambda are bounded by the proved bulk-log integrability;
in fact A_lambda->1/(2e). The last value follows by integrating
-2x log(sqrt(e)x) from zero to exp(-1/2).

With beta_lambda->beta and the bounded remainder

    R_lambda=-lambda A_lambda,

we still have the EXACT physical decomposition

    Xi_lambda=W_lambda-beta_lambda+r_lambda+R_lambda=0. (9)

Thus the certificate satisfies the usual scalar rate decomposition
with |R_lambda|<=C lambda, exact logarithmic normalization, actual
cap incidences, the full inverse kernel, every moving-hinge tail,
every convex stress, and even an exact averaged cap-volume budget.
The common critical volume of each individual cap is a much stronger
condition and is deliberately not inferred from this average.

## 5. Exact limitations and the conclusion supported

This is not a counterexample to OC or to selected-minimum stationarity.
Most caps H_(lambda,s), s>0 fixed, have volume approaching the whole
body, while H_empty has volume zero. Hence their volumes are NOT the
common critical mass beta_lambda M_lambda. Their source-contact and
separator-row identities have not been supplied. The law is continuous;
it need not be representable by the uniformly bounded finite critical
menu in an actual selected-minimum certificate. The explicit bounded
remainder in (9) is not asserted to equal the selected energy/covariance
remainder. These are substantive missing hypotheses.

What IS proved is that the scalar same-scale stress decomposition and
all its convex/entropy consequences, even together with actual geometric
inverse defects and actual cap selectors, allow a positive top-rate
inverse defect with no physical Jordan flow and no noninside captured
mass. The new entropy bounds therefore cannot alone furnish a positive
universal lower bound on v_e^noninside(R) in terms of v_e(R). One must
use additional actual critical-contact structure to produce and fund a
nontrivial distinct-endpoint subflow. Assigning an arbitrary pairing to
(4) would not be a use of the actual physical martingale, which here has
zero mass.
